paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 3.25, representing a 4.42% decrease from the prior close and a 31.97% decrease over 23 sessions. There have been 7 new news articles in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include Fermi America amending the terms of an equipment supply loan from MUFG Bank, Cantor Fitzgerald reducing their price target on Fermi stock, and the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission supporting a license for four AP1000 reactors at Fermi America's Project Matador. Additionally, there have been reports of major shareholders selling shares of the stock, including Toby Neugebauer selling 1,297,200 shares and 2,750,000 shares in separate transactions.

There have been various SEC filings recently, including an 8-K form announcing an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement and Form 4 and Form 144 filings related to insider transactions. The company has also posted a fact sheet on its website regarding its lease with TensorWave at the Project Matador site.
